name: Baked peppers stuffed with quinoa and beans

steps.text: Halve the peppers and remove the seeds. Preheat the oven to 200°C.
Mix quinoa, beans, diced tomato and onion, cumin, chilli, oil and salt and fill the pepper halves.
Bake for 30 minutes until the peppers are tender and the filling is hot.
steps.cue: The pepper walls are tender when a knife goes in, the skins have wrinkled slightly, and the filling is steaming.
steps.tip: Cover loosely with foil for the first 20 minutes if the tops brown too fast.

steps.text: Serve each plate with 50 g Greek yogurt.
